crossRefs.note: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever…
For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven…
My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the…
And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…
All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world…
If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

translations.web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
translations.bsb: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
translations.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
translations.asv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:
